name: Micronaut Core 5.2.21
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Keep a property source added while the environment loads its configuration files after the next refresh by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14162
* Keep lookups from failing while a property source is added to the running environment by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14167
* Answer a streamed multipart body cut before its closing boundary with the bad request by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14166
* Answer a streamed request body over the size limit with 413 for a streaming response by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14164
* Delegate the default AnnotationMetadata methods of environment aware metadata to the backing metadata by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14172
* KSP: include the owner in KotlinNativeElement.hashCode by @bookernath in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14180
### Other Changes 💡
* Type PollingConditions variables so eventually blocks assert their conditions by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13980
* Process a property source added just before a refresh reads only once, in its order by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14171
* Close disabled and rejected config importers by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14182

## New Contributors
* @bookernath made their first contribution in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/14180

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.20...v5.2.21
